name: ReverseV4Hook
description: For dynamic-fee pools. beforeSwap sets the LP fee: lower for a swapper who holds a credential and came through one named router, the base fee otherwise. Every swap pays a hook fee on its input into a per-pool pot held as ERC-6909 claims. A credential holder's PositionManager position is credited a bonus on the LP fees it collects, out of the pot, and withdraws it with claim. A fixed treasury may sweep a fixed share of the hook fees. Donations revert. No owner, no upgrade path.

source.inherits: This repository's HookFeePotTemplate, FeesCollectedTemplate, SwapperIdentity and FeeOverride, over OpenZeppelin uniswap-hooks BaseHook at bd5287c4a9f5c22c2393f7587a9b357662916115

reasons: Dynamic fee: beforeSwap returns a fee override on every swap.
beforeSwapReturnsDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta: the hook fee changes what the swapper pays.
Swaps and liquidity changes work with empty hookData; the hook never reads it.

pool.binding: None. Any dynamic-fee pool may name this hook; each PoolId has its own pot per currency.
pool.fee: Dynamic only (0x800000). beforeInitialize reverts PoolFeeNotDynamic for a static fee.
pool.currencies: Any. Native ETH as currency0 is covered by tests: the fee, the pot, the sweep and the claim.

state.name: pot
writtenBy: sweep (subtracts what the treasury is paid)

state.name: owed
writtenBy: claim (sets the caller's entry to zero)

state.name: feesTaken
writtenBy: beforeSwap, afterSwap (add the hook fee); never reduced

math.expression: hook fee = input * hookFee / 1e6. Exact-input: input is the amount requested. Exact-output: input is what the pool charged.

math.rounding: down, in the pot's favour; a short pot pays what it holds

math.expression: constructor requires treasuryShare * hookFee + bonusRate * baseFee <= hookFee * 1e6

deltas.returns: BeforeSwapDelta (hook fee, 0) on an exact-input swap, (0, 0) otherwise; LP fee with the override flag
deltas.currency: specified currency, which is the input of an exact-input swap
deltas.settledBy: The hook, in the same callback, by minting itself ERC-6909 claims for that amount. The pool swaps the requested amount less the fee.

deltas.returns: int128 hook fee on an exact-output swap, 0 otherwise
deltas.currency: unspecified currency, which is the input of an exact-output swap
deltas.settledBy: The hook, in the same callback, by minting itself ERC-6909 claims for that amount. The swapper's router pays it on top of what the pool charged.
Nobody. The bonus is a ledger entry; it moves no currency until claim.
The hook burns its claims and takes the same amount to the claimer or the treasury; the two cancel.

externalCalls.why: Set at deployment and never changed. Only this address is asked who the swapper is. In try/catch.
Immutable, set at deployment. In try/catch; a revert counts as no credential.
Immutable, set at deployment. In try/catch; a burned token earns no bonus.
The PoolManager the hook was deployed for.

accessControl.caller: anyone, for their own balance only
accessControl.enforcedBy: reads owed[msg.sender]; reverts NothingToClaim at zero

accessControl.caller: anyone; it pays only the immutable treasury
accessControl.enforcedBy: the amount is capped by sweepable(); reverts NothingToSweep at zero

securityAssumptions: The credential registry answers honestly. Whoever can grant a credential can grant the lower fee and the bonus.
The named swap router reports its real caller from msgSender().
The named PositionManager sets a position's salt to its token id and its ownerOf names the holder.
The treasury address can receive the currencies swept. If it cannot, only sweep fails.
doesNotGuarantee: Does not charge the hook fee on what an exact-input swap actually used. It is taken before the swap, on the amount requested, so a swap that stops at its price limit has paid the fee on all of it. A requested amount whose fee does not fit an int128 reverts.

Does not guarantee a bonus to the last wei at every setting. The constructor keeps the treasury's share out of the part of the pot bonuses can use, but the hook fee rounds down and the LP fee rounds up: with the two shares adding to exactly 100% a bonus can be short by a wei or two per swap. A treasury share a tenth of a percent under the bound absorbs that for any swap large enough to pay a hook fee at all.
Does not pay out what neither bonuses nor the treasury's share use; that remainder stays in the hook.
Does not guarantee the full bonus. Swaps under 1e6 / hookFee wei pay LP fees but no hook fee; a pot short for that reason pays what it holds.
Does not pay a bonus on fees still uncollected when a position is burned: the PositionManager burns the token first, so there is no owner to credit.
Does not pay a bonus to positions held through any contract other than the named PositionManager, or give the member fee through any router other than the named one.
Does not tie the bonus to how long the credential was held: it is checked when fees are collected, so a position can be transferred to a holder before collecting.
Does not accept donations on its pools.
Does not restrict which pools use it. Anyone can initialise a dynamic-fee pool that names this hook.
Fee-on-transfer and rebasing tokens are not covered by a test.

invariants.statement: The hook's address carries exactly the eight flags it declares, mask 0x25EC.
The constructor rejects an address missing one of the eight bits.

After any mix of swaps, fee collections, claims and sweeps, the claims the hook holds in each currency equal the pot plus everything owed, and the treasury has never been paid more than treasuryShare of the hook fees taken.
A swap is charged memberFee only for a credential holder who came through the named router; otherwise baseFee. Read from the PoolManager's Swap event.
An exact-input swap pays hookFee of its input into the input currency's pot, and the swapper pays exactly what they asked to.
An exact-output swap pays hookFee of what the pool charged, on top, into the input currency's pot.
An exact-input swap that stops at its price limit has paid the hook fee on the amount requested.
A second copy of the same router is not believed.
A registry that reverts does not stop a swap; it is charged baseFee.
Of two equal positions, only the credential holder's collection is credited, with bonusRate of the fees collected.
The bonus rule never returns more than the pot holds, and returns the full bonus when the pot allows.
An LP who swaps against their own position puts into each currency's pot at least what their bonus takes out of it.
When the pot holds less than the full bonus, the member is credited exactly what it holds.
A donation reverts.
A constructor bonus rate the hook fee does not cover reverts.
No caller other than the PoolManager can run a callback or the unlock callback.
A sweep, called by anyone, pays only the treasury, exactly its share, and a second sweep has nothing to take.
A sweep cannot reach what has been credited to an LP.
A treasury share that reaches into the part of the hook fees bonuses can use is refused at deployment.

With a treasury share a tenth of a percent under the bound, every position holding the credential, and the treasury sweeping all it may after every swap of at least 1e12 wei, each collection is credited its bonus in full, to the wei.
A bonus on fees earned in native ETH is paid in ETH, and the hook never holds ETH itself.
A claimer that claims again while being paid ETH is paid once.
A claimer that refuses ETH fails only its own claim; it is still owed and the pool still trades.

deployments.note: Deployed and used once on chain; not source-verified on the explorer. The credential registry is a testnet registry with a single issuer.

liveFire.notShown: The base fee for a swapper without the credential: the one signer holds it. That path is covered by the fork tests only.
